key.name: hold-delay-ms
key.summary: How long to hold at the edge before the picker opens

key.name: follow-delay-ms
key.summary: How long to hold over a workspace in the picker until it fills up

key.name: follow-start-delay-ms
key.summary: How long to wait over a workspace in the picker before it starts filling up

key.name: drop-action
key.summary: Whether to stay on the current workspace or go with the window when dropping it

key.name: left-enabled
key.summary: Use the left screen edge

key.name: left-zone-start
key.summary: Top of the left edge's zone, as a percentage of its height

key.name: left-zone-end
key.summary: Bottom of the left edge's zone, as a percentage of its height

key.name: right-enabled
key.summary: Use the right screen edge

key.name: right-zone-start
key.summary: Top of the right edge's zone, as a percentage of its height

key.name: right-zone-end
key.summary: Bottom of the right edge's zone, as a percentage of its height

key.name: link-edges
key.summary: Use the same zone on both edges

key.name: edge-depth
key.summary: How close to the edge the pointer has to be, in pixels

key.name: monitors
key.summary: Which monitors' edges move windows

key.name: shared-edges
key.summary: Holding at an edge between two monitors opens the workspace picker

key.name: top-edge
key.summary: Holding at the top edge opens a picker with every workspace

key.name: excluded-apps
key.summary: Application IDs whose windows are never moved

key.name: number-keys
key.summary: Pressing a number while dragging chooses that workspace

key.name: app-modifier
key.summary: Key that moves all of an app's windows on the workspace while held

key.name: picker-gesture
key.summary: How to do the opposite of the usual drop in the picker: drop on one part of a workspace, or hold over it

key.name: split-side
key.summary: Which part of a workspace in the picker does the opposite of the usual drop: the inner part, away from the screen edge, or the outer part, next to it

key.name: split-percent
key.summary: How much of each workspace in the picker does the opposite of the usual drop, in percent

key.name: hold-to-follow
key.summary: Holding over a workspace in the picker does the opposite of the usual drop

key.name: follow-modifier
key.summary: Key that does the opposite of the usual drop while held

key.name: right-click-to-go
key.summary: Right-clicking while dragging moves the window and goes with it

key.name: offer-new-workspace
key.summary: Offer a new workspace as a target

key.name: show-hint
key.summary: Highlight zones while dragging a window near them

key.name: show-confirmation
key.summary: Briefly show the destination workspace after a move, with Undo and Go buttons

key.name: popup-duration-ms
key.summary: How long the popup after a move stays up, in milliseconds

key.name: popup-buttons
key.summary: Which buttons the popup after a move has

key.name: popup-position
key.summary: Where the popup after a move appears

key.name: show-workspace-names
key.summary: Show workspace names on previews in the picker

key.name: show-app-icons
key.summary: Show the icons of a workspace's apps on its preview in the picker

key.name: animate-throw
key.summary: Animate moved windows sliding off the edge

key.name: card-width
key.summary: Largest width of a workspace card in the picker, in pixels
